summary: Independent verification advances the Student World -> Jose bridge from static-only to static + local browser-interaction evidence. Candidate source/authority, candidate byte parity, current donor blob identity, Jose Study R13 source and Jose Algebra source all check out. Headless Chromium smoke against the exact candidate HTML passes route-rail open/close, Escape close and responsive visibility at 1280x800, 360x740 and 320x568. Public github.io HTTP propagation and live destination navigation remain unverified because this worker runtime cannot resolve/access the Pages host. One fidelity caveat is material: metadata records donor blob a2f7a16..., but the iframe runtime src is the mutable live Pages URL rather than an immutable blob/version URL, so exact donor preservation is true at the checked branch state but is not mechanically pinned against future donor drift.

PASS candidate byte identity: published canary blob 35133e9a92ad7014b3ef3cfa46be15e36e4d4266 matches implementation receipt.
PASS current donor identity at verification time: gh-pages Student World blob is a2f7a16beaf2d6c44556c87434bccfc4cb168b50, matching candidate metadata.
PASS source existence: Jose Study index blob 5ed0524a6a8109b3ccf9d96137d81c521751eec4 is R13; Jose Algebra gh-pages blob cede30166db8526df121c47b475840d14460e35f exists.
PASS local headless interaction at 1280x800: route panel opens to 320px, both route anchors are visible, Escape closes and aria-expanded returns false.
PASS local headless interaction at 360x740: 300px route panel is visible with both route anchors; Escape closes.
PASS local headless interaction at 320x568: responsive panel remains on-screen with both route anchors visible; Escape closes.
UNVERIFIED public canary HTTP/Pages propagation: network runtime cannot resolve the github.io host.
UNVERIFIED live navigation HTTP: external Pages destinations could not be independently loaded from this runtime.
unresolved: A network-capable verifier must fetch the public canary and both live destinations after Pages propagation and record actual HTTP/browser success.

The donor blob pin is documentary metadata only; iframe runtime points to the mutable live Student World URL. If immutable donor fidelity is required, add an exact-version asset/reference or drift detection before any promotion.
Candidate remains CANDIDATE_NOT_CURRENT_NOT_SERVED; this verification does not authorize promotion.
